meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求用大白话解释某个技术事物时,Claude 不再甩术语,而是按“谁、什么、哪里、为什么、何时”五个角度拆开讲清楚。
howto.when: 当你想要某个技术内容的通俗版说明,想弄明白其中的关键角色、来龙去脉时触发。

say.text: 用大白话给我讲讲区块链是什么?
say.note: Claude 会按五个方面拆解说明。

say.text: 解释一下 API,说清楚谁在用、为了什么。
say.note: 它会从谁、为什么等角度解释。

say.text: “负载均衡”到底解决什么问题?
say.note: 同样会拆成谁、何时等角度讲。

howto.what_en: When you ask for a plain-English explanation of something technical, Claude breaks it down into who, what, where, why, and when — no jargon.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a plain-language breakdown of a technical topic, covering the key players, context, and reasoning.

say_en.text: What is an API? Who uses it and why?
say_en.note: It explains from who and why.

say_en.text: What problem does load balancing solve?
say_en.note: It breaks it down the same way.
